'''Freyden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Army]] who was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
